tools.name: search-mail
tools.title: Search Mail
tools.description: Search the user's Nyxe mailbox by keywords, sender or subject and return matching threads.

tools.name: get-thread
tools.title: Get Thread
tools.description: Read a full email thread (every message, as plain text) by its thread id.

tools.name: list-inbox
tools.title: List Inbox
tools.description: List the newest threads in the user's Nyxe inbox, optionally only unread ones.

tools.name: create-reply-draft
tools.title: Create Reply Draft
tools.description: Create a reply draft in a thread. The draft is saved in Nyxe for the user to review and send; it is never sent.

tools.name: send-email
tools.title: Send Email
tools.description: Send a new email from the user's Nyxe address. Asks the user to confirm first.

tools.name: archive-thread
tools.title: Archive Thread
tools.description: Archive a thread (move it out of the inbox). Asks the user to confirm first.

ai.instructions: You are helping the user with their Nyxe Mail mailbox. Thread ids come from search-mail or list-inbox results; never invent one. Read a thread with get-thread before summarizing it or drafting a reply to it. Prefer create-reply-draft over send-email when the user wants to answer a thread: a draft lets them review it in Nyxe before it goes out. Only call send-email when the user clearly asked to send a new message, and include every recipient they named. Keep replies in the user's language and tone. Sign-in and verification codes are deliberately not available to you; if asked for one, tell the user to run the Copy Sign-In Code command.
